story_type: basket hoist from a boat pitching in whitecaps, door camera, Alaska winter
hook: A man was hurt on this boat as it rolled through whitecaps.
narration: This boat was plowing through whitecaps off Alaska, and a man aboard was hurt.
It was February, and a Jayhawk crew from Air Station Kodiak was standing by in Cold Bay.
The helicopter came in low over the vessel Arica as she rolled in the swell.
The flight mechanic leans out the door and guides the basket down by hand, calling every move to the pilot.
The basket touched the rolling deck and came back up with him inside.
outcome: The crew pulled him into the Jayhawk and flew him on to medical care in Anchorage.
title: Basket hoist from a rolling Alaska boat
description:
On Feb. 10, 2014, an Air Station Kodiak MH-60 Jayhawk crew forward deployed to Cold Bay, Alaska, hoisted an injured man off the vessel Arica.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Kodiak, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/321890

question_comment: Would you trust that basket with the deck moving under you?

facts.claim: Kodiak Jayhawk crew forward deployed to Cold Bay rescued an injured man from the Arica
facts.source_quote: An Air Station Kodiak MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew forward deployed to Cold Bay, Alaska, rescues an injured man from the vessel Arica, Feb. 10, 2014.
The man was safely transported to emergency medical services in Anchorage for further care.

drop_reason: QA Nov 17: Hoist-cam footage is smeared with heavy color noise and the top-down frames are hard to read in the first second; a third Kodiak Jayhawk hoist in this batch, interchangeable with recent Alaska hoists.
